result.summary: Re-gate confirms the S1 ordering fix holds structurally and empirically. Consent check happens before any chapter code in the main handler; consent is recorded before assignChapterOrPrompt is ever called in the consent callback; the chapter-selection keyboard is only ever sent post-consent. Independently rebuilt the dispatch harness and reproduced null-chapter_id-through-consent for both 1-active and 2-active cases, plus the returning-consented-chapterless case. AC1/3/4/5/6 unaffected. Design-doc correction note confirmed accurate.
